risk_tiers.local-readonly: No network, no credentials, no spend. Record source identity only.
risk_tiers.network-no-credentials: Public endpoints, no keys or payment. Record contacted endpoints; do not upload raw data or credentials.
risk_tiers.credentials-or-paid: Requires keys, a paid provider, or GPU service. Keep keys out of files, URLs, argv and logs; HTTPS only; record model identity; every attempt counts against the cumulative total.

guardrails.output_status: advisory until hash-bound, independently verified and linked to evidence

notes: deployment_authorized is a permission; standalone_runtime_deployed is an observed fact. Never infer one from the other. Historical reviewed snapshots in upstreams.lock.json and research-automation-tools.json are deliberately unchanged.
